source_refs.note: 5. Large Number of Particles: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Gas mein particles bohat zyada hote hain. Itni bari number ki wajah se gas ki properties statistical methods (average aur hisab ke tareeqe) se bayan ki ja sakti hain.
